title: Swarm live fire unplaceable in the automatable-manual split
description: QE and SA convergent: it produces a fixture rather than consuming one. Fix: a third class — one-time live-fire acts with a named owner (operator-triggered, record becomes the reference fixture) — holding swarm live fire and any future live-fire preconditions. [owner: quality-engineer; validator: solution-owner]
